meta.name: agent-hierarchy
meta.description: Designs orchestrator-and-subagent hierarchies for a repository — splitting agents by exclusive write surface, pairing every producer with an independent auditor, and enforcing the split with a script that runs in CI. Use this whenever the user wants to set up, expand, audit, or fix a multi-agent or subagent structure for a codebase; asks how to divide work between agents; wants agent charters, roles, or a surface map written; or is hitting agents that collide on the same files, review their own work, or drift from their remit. Also use when sizing a roster or deciding whether a new agent is justified.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划智能体分工并自动校验职责不越界
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正搭建多智能体团队，想理清分工并防止它们越权改代码
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-agent hierarchies that never collide
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run several coding agents on a repo and want them to never collide

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 帮你把多个 AI 助手按“谁改哪些文件”分工,而不是按话题;一个总助手负责提交,每个写文件的助手配一个独立检查者,并用脚本在 CI 里强制检查规则。
howto.when: 当你想为代码库设置或调整多助手结构、询问如何给助手分工,或遇到助手编辑同一文件、自己审自己时触发。

say.text: 帮我把代码库的 AI 助手按文件范围拆分,并给每个配独立的检查者。
say.note: 它会先盘点文件,再给出名单和 surface map。

say.text: 我的两个助手都会改同一个文件,怎么办?
say.note: 它会按独占写表面重新划分职责。

say.text: 我该不该新增一个 Agent?
say.note: 它会结合现有名单规模和职责来判断。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude help you split multiple AI assistants by which files they may write, not by topic; a lead assistant is the sole committer, every file-writing assistant gets an independent reviewer, and a script enforces the rules in CI.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to set up or adjust a multi-assistant structure for a codebase, ask how to divide work between assistants, or hit assistants that edit the same files or review their own work.

say_en.text: Help me split my codebase's AI assistants by file scope, and pair each with an independent reviewer.
say_en.note: It will inventory the files, then propose a roster and a surface map.

say_en.text: Two of my assistants keep editing the same file — what do I do?
say_en.note: It will re-draw boundaries so each has an exclusive write surface.

say_en.text: Should I add a new assistant?
say_en.note: It will assess it against the current roster size and remit.
